name: Shanidar Cave
description: Shanidar Cave is an archaeological site in the Zagros Mountains in Erbil Governorate. The Kurdistan Regional Government representation in the United States identifies it as a major site associated with Neanderthal remains. Its significance relates to the study of early human history in the region.
